judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete and stops mid-way through its own plan. While it adds `ajv` to `package.json` and compiles schemas during `ToolRegistry.register`, it never actually modifies `ToolRegistry.execute` to run the compiled validator or return a rejection `ToolResponse`. Consequently, 3 out of the 4 acceptance tests added by the candidate in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. It also misses dynamic schema caching via `WeakMap`, most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `.specify/spec.md`.
